title: Barradas
summary: Raleigh names Barradas in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Barradas, named with Salmeron, Montanus, Ribera, Azorius, Villalpandus, and Pineda, on the building of the Temple. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVIII, §. II, sig. 303b
